source.titlesResolvedBy: vitest.collect() of the storage project (no server, no hooks, no test executed) from the scratchpad; privilege arrays evaluated from lib/src/common/constants/privileges.ts with tsx

privilegeLiterals.undefined: myPrivileges asserted toEqual(undefined): the GraphQL lookup returns null for the entity, i.e. the user cannot even read the parent

ANONYMOUS.credentialsHeldInScenario: none — graphqlRequestAuth(…, undefined) posts to the private GraphQL endpoint with NO Authorization header; getAuthDocument(…, undefined) GETs /storage/document/{id} with no bearer
ANONYMOUS.notes: the unauthenticated caller; its privileges rows are what "the public" sees

NON_SPACE_MEMBER.credentialsHeldInScenario: registered platform user (GLOBAL_REGISTERED) with no space, subspace or organization role in any of the 9 scenarios
NON_SPACE_MEMBER.notes: the "authenticated outsider"; in every table its expectation equals the ANONYMOUS row

GLOBAL_ADMIN.credentialsHeldInScenario: platform roles only (creator of every scenario entity, but never assigned a space/org role). workspace#027 Slice B: the server bootstraps admin@ with PLATFORM_ROLES_ADMIN, PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_ADMIN, PLATFORM_USERS_ADMIN, PLATFORM_SETTINGS_ADMIN; the harness globalSetup (server-api/src/globalTestsSetup.ts -> lib ensureHarnessAdminRoles) then grants PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS, PLATFORM_SUPPORT, PLATFORM_RESOURCE_ADMIN, PLATFORM_LICENSE_MANAGER via a second Roles Admin fixture.
GLOBAL_ADMIN.notes: 8 of the 14 027 roles (lib/src/scenario/platform-roles/harness-admin-roles.ts, platform-role-users.ts). The source of the bootstrap four is the comment in harness-admin-roles.ts, not a query. Caveat: on a Slice-A server admin@ reaches content through the legacy global-admin cascade credential instead of the PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS role (ensureHarnessAdminRoles is a no-op then) — the expected lists are the same either way. In every `_globalAdmin` constant the delta vs the plain constant is exactly +PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS (root rule, cascade:true); on USER documents the delta is +PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS +READ_USER_SETTINGS (from platform-users-admin) and the user-document constants for GLOBAL_ADMIN carry no GRANT and no UPDATE_NAMEID, unlike the owner QA_USER rows.

SPACE_ADMIN.credentialsHeldInScenario: L0 ADMIN + L0 MEMBER (community.admins + community.members of the L0 block) in the 6 space files; NOT a member/admin of L1 or L2
SPACE_ADMIN.notes: L0 admin rights cascade to L1/L2 content in the expectations (same lists as SUBSPACE_ADMIN on L1 resources)

SPACE_MEMBER.credentialsHeldInScenario: L0 MEMBER only in the 6 space files; organization ASSOCIATE in organization-document-auth (assignRoleToUser RoleName.Associate in beforeAll)
SPACE_MEMBER.notes: the interesting role in the subspace variants: an L0 member who is NOT an L1 member

SUBSPACE_ADMIN.credentialsHeldInScenario: L0 MEMBER; L1 ADMIN + L1 MEMBER in the four -ch files; organization ADMIN in organization-document-auth (assignRoleToUser RoleName.Admin in beforeAll, no Associate role)
SUBSPACE_ADMIN.notes: rows only in the 4 subspace files and the organization file

SUBSPACE_MEMBER.credentialsHeldInScenario: L0 MEMBER; L1 MEMBER in the four -ch files
SUBSPACE_MEMBER.notes: rows only in the 4 subspace files

SUBSUBSPACE_ADMIN / SUBSUBSPACE_MEMBER.credentialsHeldInScenario: L0 MEMBER (all 6 space files); L1 MEMBER (4 -ch files); L2 ADMIN/MEMBER in public-space-private-ch only
SUBSUBSPACE_ADMIN / SUBSUBSPACE_MEMBER.notes: provisioned by the scenario but NEVER used as a userRole row in the storage suites; the L2 of public-space-private-ch has no resource under test

QA_USER.credentialsHeldInScenario: owner of the user profile under test in user-document-auth (uploads as itself); no space/org roles

ORGANIZATION_ADMIN.credentialsHeldInScenario: organization ASSOCIATE + ADMIN on the scenario organization (TestScenarioFactory.createOrganization assigns both by default)
ORGANIZATION_ADMIN.notes: organization-document file only; identical expectations to SUBSPACE_ADMIN (org ADMIN without Associate)

L0.note: members self-join while the fresh space is still OPEN (Slice B ensureSpaceMembers), admins assigned by GLOBAL_ADMIN, then privacy is applied

scenario.callouts: L0 (and L1 where present) created with addPostCallout/addPostCollectionCallout/addWhiteboardCallout; addTutorialCallouts:false on L0; every callout under test is created fresh in the describe beforeAll by GLOBAL_ADMIN
